meta.title: iOS Trainer
lang.label: Language
lessons.title: Interactive lessons
lessons.lead: Each lesson explains a concept with examples and their output, and makes you practice it right away: predict what it prints, fill the gap or write the function. You can't move on until you solve the exercise. Follow the order: each one builds on the previous one.
player.reviewPrev: Review the previous explanation and try again.
player.patternNote: Pattern check only, Swift is not executed. Compare with the solution to fine-tune.
quiz.title: Quiz with feedback
quiz.lead: Multiple-choice questions like the 10-minute TestGorilla tests. Every answer explains why, whether you got it right or not.
output.title: Predict the output
output.lead: Read the Swift code and decide what it prints (or whether it compiles). The most direct training for the language's traps.
output.question: What does this code print?
flash.title: Flashcards
flash.lead: Read the question, answer in your head, flip it and be honest: "I knew it" removes it from the deck, "Repeat" sends it to the back.
flash.deckDoneText: No cards left with this filter. Switch topic or turn off "Pending only" to review everything.
code.title: Write the code
code.lead: No autocomplete, like the TestGorilla editor. Write the whole function from memory and submit: you get a checklist of what a good solution needs, warnings about common mistakes and the reference solution to compare.
code.note: This check looks for the key constructs; it doesn't run Swift. Compare with the solution and walk through your edge cases: empty, one element, duplicates, k > n.
bugs.title: Bug hunt
bugs.lead: Like the "Coding: Debugging" test: read the description, find the line that breaks the behavior and click it.
bugs.wrongLine: No. The bug is on line {n}.
interview.title: Technical interview
interview.lead: Questions that may come up as custom questions (essay or video) and in the technical interview. Answer out loud or write your answer, then compare with the key points and rate yourself.
interview.placeholder: Write your answer (or say it out loud and note the points you mentioned)…
interview.autoNote: Points detected in your text are checked automatically; tick the ones you said out loud.
interview.scale: 1 = no idea where to start · 3 = the idea but disorganized · 5 = ready to say it in an interview.
theory.title: Quick reference
theory.lead: A compressed summary of the whole syllabus to review the day before. To learn each topic from scratch, go to
sync.title: ☁️ Cloud progress
sync.desc: Everything you do is saved automatically. On another device, enter the same code.
sync.state.error: Sync error (retries on the next change)
sync.state.unavailable: Server has no database configured: local only
exam.intro: {n} multiple-choice questions. You pass with 70%. Every answer is explained.
exam.question: Question {n} / {total}
exam.passed: Passed. Move on to the next course.
exam.failed: Not yet: review the lessons and flashcards and try again.
home.title: iOS Trainer
home.lead: Short, interactive modules to go from zero to iOS architect. Each module has lessons, flashcards, practice and a quiz, and your progress is saved to the cloud.
home.allDone: You completed every module. Keep reviewing with practice and flashcards whenever you like.
home.how.1: One module at a time, in order: each builds on the previous ones. Don't binge every lesson first.
home.how.2: Inside a module, lesson by lesson: each comes with its exercises, and you can't move on until you solve them.
home.how.3: After each session, 5–10 minutes of the module's flashcards. The ones you miss come back; repeat them the next day.
home.how.4: When the lessons are done, Practice: it mixes every exercise in the module without the explanations.
home.how.5: Finish with the Quiz (70% to pass) and move to the next module. The Continue button always takes you to the next step.
modules.title: Modules
modules.lead: 20 modules in teaching order, from Swift from scratch to iOS architect. Each module: interactive lessons with a final challenge, flashcards, mixed practice and a quiz.
modules.levelsHelp: N0 fundamentals · N1 junior · N2 mid · N3 senior · N4 architect
modules.loadError: Couldn't load the module. Check your connection and reload.
module.next.flashcards: Next: review the flashcards you haven't mastered
module.next.quiz: Next: take the quiz (70% to pass)
module.next.done: Module complete. Move on to the next one.
practice.lead: Every exercise in the module, shuffled and without the explanations. Great for reviewing before the quiz.
prep.title: TestGorilla prep
prep.description: The original syllabus for the TestGorilla iOS Sr assessment: standalone lessons, flashcards, quiz, predict the output, write the code, bug hunt, interview and quick reference.
gate.title: Your personal code
gate.desc: This code saves your progress to the cloud. Use the same one on every device to pick up where you left off. If you already have one, type it; otherwise create a new one.
gate.invalid: Only letters, numbers, - or _, between 6 and 64 characters.
gate.note: If you already used the app in this browser, that progress is added to your code. Anyone who knows the code can see that progress: don't use a real password.
sync.signOutConfirm: Your progress is uploaded to the cloud and removed from this device. Sign out?
sync.signOutFailed: Couldn't upload your progress to the cloud; nothing was deleted. Try again when you're online.
